checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Stock and ETF options
facts.text: Standard stock and ETF option orders have $0 commissions and $0 contract fees. Regulatory and exchange fees may apply.

facts.label: Index and oversized orders
facts.text: Index options cost $0.50 per contract plus applicable exchange and regulatory fees. Non-index option orders above 500 contracts carry a $0.10 per-contract fee.

facts.label: Stocks and ETFs
facts.text: Webull advertises $0 commissions on eligible U.S.-listed stock and ETF trading in self-directed accounts. Other services, securities and trading costs have separate schedules.
